desc: Ideation complete; choose the right-endpoint run-length deque approach.

Implement the right-endpoint run-length deque solution: a helper that maintains (value, count) runs for active starts, updates current extremum sum, expires oldest start when active_count > k, and accumulates; minMaxSubarraySum returns max helper + min helper.
Run sample tests and edge cases (k=1, k=n, duplicates, negative values, large n) and compare against brute force for small random arrays to confirm correctness and O(n) performance.
